text:
alex: Quick heads-up - infra plans a CMK rotation for the SIEM export key next Tue (rolling). I also want to reduce default security log retention from 365d -> 90d in the same window. Need to confirm RBAC impact and an ops playbook for exports. Any blockers?

maria: timeline? will this affect partners pulling exports? :thinking_face:

alex: rotation window 02:00-04:00 UTC Tue. Partners using export proxy may see brief failures unless they rekey. Retention change should be opt-out for internal teams, opt-in for external consumers.

kevin: tagging oncall 1 1 do we have automation to update exporter configs and enforce TTLs?
oncall: we have a job that updates S3 lifecycle rules and a lambda that updates the export manifest, but it assumes retention=365. Need a patch to accept variable TTLs.

irene: compliance note: 90d fine for telemetry. Forensics/evidence needs longer. Propose exception workflow: 1-click JIT snapshot request that stores a masked copy for 180d with approval and audit trail.

maria: +1 on JIT snapshot. Also: must scrub PII before any external export.

alex: proposed steps: 1) patch exporter to support export_ttl_days param, 2) insert pre-export scrub stage, 3) update RBAC so only "security:analyst" and "platform:forensics" can request snapshots, 4) rotate CMK and publish new key metadata, 5) dry-run export job and notify partners.

kevin: draft config for exporter pipeline: 

```
{
  "exporter": "siem-proxy-v2",
  "export_ttl_days": 90,
  "masking_profile": "pii-default",
  "snapshot_retention_days": 180,
  "allowed_roles": ["security:analyst", "platform:forensics"]
}
```

kevin: we can roll back by setting export_ttl_days=365.

irene: RBAC change needs a short RFC + owner and a ticket for access reviews. Who owns that?

alex: maria owns RFC, kevin owns infra change, irene owns compliance sign-off. I'll own rollout coordination and partner comms.

maria: I'll write the RFC this afternoon. Q: ephemeral KMS grants for oncall during rotation or full rewrap?

oncall: ephemeral unwrap grants (JIT) are safer. We'll generate short-lived decrypt tokens for the export service during rotation window, scoped to the new key. No human manual unwrapping.

sec-bot: NOTE: Upcoming CMK rotation scheduled by infra on 1765440000. Expect automated key alias reassignment.

kevin: action items: patch exporter to accept export_ttl_days; add masking hook; add preflight dry-run; update docs. ETA: EOD Monday for PR.

maria: I'll include partner notification language and an opt-out form for internal teams in the RFC. Opt-out: "request longer retention with justification and duration".

irene: I'll build the exception workflow and JIT approval template (fields: justification, incident ticket link, approver). Log approval events to audit and tie to CMK key-ids.

alex: IR playbook tweak: if we detect compromise during rotation, abort rotation and preserve keys/snapshots. Add: "if IR opens a Sev1, hold rotation".

maria: consumer tokens unaffected; exports obey TTL at creation. We'll publish policy and ask consumers to refresh ingest.

kevin: ok owners and next steps. I'll file rollout ticket linking RFC + infra PR + partner comms. Test on staging tomorrow and run simulated partner replay.

maria: ping me after staging test and I'll finalize RFC. :thumbsup:

kevin: staging test scheduled 10:00 UTC tomorrow, will post logs here.

sec-bot: After-action reminder: create audit alert for any export requests >90d without exception tag.

alex: closing loop. If regulatory concerns appear, call them out in RFC. Otherwise execute plan.

irene: noted. I'll add checklist for evidence preservation to IR runbook.

oncall: on rotation watch Tue 01:30-05:00 UTC. Will escalate on failures.

alex: thanks everyone.
